units.source_text: 寺庙的师兄弟来唤我的时候，禅海和尚对我表示了想在等候老师回庙的这段时间里同我闲谈的意向，我有点踌躇。

en.t: When the senior monks from the temple came to call me, Monk Zenkai told me that he wished to chat with me while we waited for the teacher to return to the temple, and I hesitated a little.

units.source_text: 因为我害怕摔海和尚的单纯而澄明的眼睛会不会着穿我今晚迫在眉睫的企图。

en.t: For I was afraid that Monk Zenkai's simple, clear eyes might see through the plan that was pressing so urgently upon me tonight.
